Definition: {a wheel; by analogy, a whirlwind; also dust (as whirled)}
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, gilgâl means wheel. It occurs just once, in Isaiah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe gilgâl needs no more than its plain sense — wheel.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
